items.name: Field
items.notes: No wiki states the field size; 2013 client data cited in PLACEMENT_RESEARCH.md places one field per tile (1x1). Unverified against the current game. | footprint not stated by en/ru/de wiki (ru wiki gives trees 1x1 and fences/paths 1x1 in the same unit, but no source states a field's size); cost 1 coin each per de wiki (https://hayday.fandom.com/de/wiki/Feld); count is level-gated: 6 at start, +3 every 2nd level until L49, +2 until L99, then +1 (ru wiki: from L701 every 4 levels, from L801 every 10; max 473 at L1000); en Farm page: 'Both [fields and trees/bushes] can be rotated'; no limit on fields owned beyond level gate
